thread:
Emma Li: Quick update 1: we're launching a Customer Reliability & Onboarding (CRO) team under Customer Success to centralize post-sale reliability, onboarding frameworks, and escalation triage. I'll be stepping into Head of CRO starting 2025-06-02.

Maya Patel: Big congrats Emma! This should help reduce handoff friction between Sales, CS, and Platform teams.

Jon Park: Congrats Emma :tada: Will CRO own the onboarding playbooks and technical QA checklists or is that still shared with Solutions?

Emma Li: CRO will own the official playbooks and the onboarding SLOs. Solutions will remain the front-line for pre-sales POCs; we'll coordinate handoff points in the playbook.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel posted event "CRO all-hands intro" Tue 09:30-10:00 1 attendees: customer-success@redwood.com

Ravi Singh: Two backfills approved: Technical Onboarding Engineer and Customer Onboarding Manager. Recruiting will post reqs tomorrow.

Tessa Nguyen: For the Tech Onboarding Eng, do we want the same infra loop as CS Platform? We need someone who can debug KV cache and routing issues in customer environments.

Ben Torres: +1 on infra-savvy candidates. Also recommend a short technical phone screen focusing on debugging and runbook usage.

Jon Park: Any change to escalation paths for Sev2/Sev1 incidents during the transition?

Emma Li: No change today. We'll publish an interim escalation map before June 9 and run a tabletop with Eng-SRE next week.

Alex Gomez: Recruiting note: target hire window 5-7 weeks for both roles. If teams need faster turnaround please flag the reqs and provide prioritized panelers.

Maya Patel: Please update the org chart and team pages by EOD Friday. Emma, schedule intro syncs with Sales Ops and Platform leads so we can align SLAs.

Emma Li: Will do. Thanks all 1 excited to get started and iterate on the onboarding experience. Ping me with any playbook items you want included in the first draft.
